description.narrative: Hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs) are classified as controlled substances under Annex-C, Group-I of the Montreal Protocol and therefore, have production and consumption restrictions and would have to be phased-out for controlled use applications. Haiti, as a Party to the Montreal Protocol, is mandated to phase out consumption of HCFCs in line with the Montreal Protocol phase-out schedule.Haiti through implementation of HPMP Stage-I has met the 2013 and 2015 compliance targets as per the accelerated phase out schedule of the Montreal Protocol for HCFCs. HPMP Stage-I was being implemented since 2012 through which the 2020 compliance target has already been achieved as per the accelerated phase out schedule of the Montreal Protocol for HCFCs. In 2022, at the ExCom 91 by decision 91/13 was decided to cancel the HPMP Stage I, second tranche for Haiti and to request UNEP to return the remaining balances in line with decision 28/7.The Ex-Com of the MLF, in its 91st meeting held in December 2022 approved the proposal
